sections.content: Use *más*, *menos* and *tan* to compare places, activities and memories. Combine them with familiar travel and opinion vocabulary and the *pretérito perfecto* when describing recent experiences.

items.spanish: El mirador es más bonito que el hotel.
items.english: The viewpoint is more beautiful than the hotel.

items.spanish: Este recuerdo es más especial que el otro.
items.english: This memory is more special than the other one.

items.spanish: Hanói es menos tranquila que Ninh Bình.
items.english: Hanoi is less quiet than Ninh Bình.

sections.content: Name both things you compare: the first before the verb, the second after *que* or *como*: *El mirador es más bonito que el hotel*.
